THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The energy model

As you record, the model fills in. Follow the energy from the sun to the phones.

THE SCENE

You are in a school contest for new inventions. Judges will give money to the best idea. Your idea is a cart that uses the sun to charge phones. It is for Welcome Night, for families new to this country. You need four numbers to show the judges your cart works. Four people each have one.

THE HISTORY

Your cart is named for Nikola Tesla. He came to New York from Europe in 1884. He sold his idea for moving electricity to a company. In 1893 his idea lit up a giant fair in Chicago.
